request.reason: The user selected real Mac child lifecycle plus controlled same-numeric-PID/different-birth-identity injection as this Work Item's PID-safety evidence. Preserve the previously planned ECHILD negative, zero unauthorized signal, cleanup Unknown, no reusable success, and unrelated-child survival. Actual kernel PID recycling remains untested and any later field defect belongs in a later Work Item.

changes.value: On Mac, run bounded test-owned child lifecycle and stale-handle fixtures with a separate unrelated test-owned process. Inject ECHILD at the production supervisor wait/signal decision; assert no numeric group signal, cleanup Unknown, no reusable success, and survival of the child and unrelated process until their fixture cleanup. Through the production Mac identity decision and a recording signal sink, inject the same numeric PID with a different birth identity both at the initial check and at the final check immediately before signal; assert zero signal calls in both negative cases, with a matching-identity positive control proving the sink is reachable. Correlate these controlled negatives with the supervised Unknown and no-reuse fixtures. Do not signal an unknown or possibly recycled PID. Record actual kernel PID reuse as untested; investigate a later field defect with its evidence in a later Work Item.

acceptanceCriteria: Mac reports directly observed verifier exit and original-group control separately from unproven escaped-descendant cleanup; no complete-tree claim.
Timeout, parent disconnect, output saturation, and cleanup errors remain bounded and produce explicit uncertainty where closure is unproven.

setsid, double-fork, closed-pipe, changed-cwd, stale owned-child handle, and controlled identity-loss negatives never become cleanup-success or reusable evidence; unrelated test-owned processes survive. Actual kernel PID reuse is not claimed as tested in this Work Item.
Cold read and restart retain Unknown; uncertainty cannot be promoted to clean by a later empty process-group probe.
Full composition supervision still rejects Mac before starting a verifier.
The nine scoped documents state HCI as the sole current North Star: understandable, controllable, explainable, recoverable; the historical map retains its historical identity.

Mac records directly observed command completion separately from descendant cleanup assurance; cleanup Unknown leaves the Work Item pending formal verification and cannot authorize a reusable receipt or finish, archive, or close.
